brief: As this ageing ONAN unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period [MG-021].
